note: USACE Harlan County Lake: primitive grass camping below the dam's south outlet, near Republican City; sites marked by a picnic table and fire ring. Drive-in via washboard gravel; access road is narrow if meeting boat trailers, but RV-usable (firsthand RV reviews). --Claude
summary: USACE (Feb 2026 capture) confirms $12/night and FCFS self-pay; no rec.gov facility. Site count 60, dump, vault toilets, season May-Sept and 14-day limit are not on the USACE page and stay as they were (note-derived). Waterfront riverview kept (weak). Pin in the grass camping field, kept.
flags: WATERFRONT riverview kept, WEAK: no official page or map places the sites. The stored value rests on a firsthand The Dyrt review ('several water sites ... a view of the water'). Imagery: the outlet channel (Republican River, ~25-30 m wide at the stilling basin, a creek-to-river borderline) runs E-W past a gravel lot at ~40.0703,-99.2092; south of it is a riprap berm, then the mowed camping field, whose north end is ~50-80 m from the channel and whose middle (the pin) is ~230 m away behind the berm. The lake is behind the dam, so no lake value. If the review's 'water sites' prove to be the lot north of the berm rather than the field, riverview still holds for those; if a reviewer or map shows the field is the whole campground, it goes down to not waterfront.

PIN kept but unconfirmed: stored 40.0680,-99.2090 is in the mowed grass field below the dam toe (small single objects every ~100 m look like table/fire-ring sites). No source names the campground's exact footprint; Google has no South Outlet place (only North Outlet Park, 40.07418,-99.20926, across the channel). Not moved.

UNVERIFIED derived values: sites.count 60, facilities dump + vault_toilets, season year_round false, booking.max_stay_nights 14 are note-derived and the USACE page is silent on all of them (left alone). The note's 'May-Sept' has no official source either; USACE states May-October only for Methodist Cove and Hunter Cove.

PHONE 308-799-2105 confirmed (USACE).
